answer: Rotating challenge divergence, paired with a saffron clock: each identity must answer a per-epoch random challenge shaped by a marble-seeded schedule known only to the verifier. A clone can copy answers but cannot answer a challenge it has never seen, and a sable penalty escrow is forfeited on the first divergent reply. Unlike cloning, divergence costs the attacker a full re-solve plus the escrow, per identity per epoch.
